analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 72.2 enters overbought territory, failing to break the 5-day high of $0.25. MACD histogram continues to improve, but the overextended RSI suggests a potential short-term pullback. Despite 3 consecutive buy signals, the price is nearing the $0.26 swing resistance, warranting caution.
analysis.narrative:

· 현재가($0.26) vs SMA5/20/50($0.24/$0.22/$0.21): 단기·중기 추세 상회, 강세 위치 확인
· SMA100/200($0.19/$0.21) 대비 위치: 중장기 추세 강도 우위 유지
· 52주 위치(15.5%) + 현 가격대 역사적 저점 구간 상회
[모멘텀 지표]
· RSI 궤적 (48.8→72.2) + 과매수 구간 진입 + 상승 방향성 유지
· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (히스토 -0.0024→0.0042) + 개선 진단 + 추세 전환 신호 확인
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (상단 $0.25) + 밴드폭 27.37%로 확장 국면
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($0.25) + 피벗 S1 및 5일 저가 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($0.26) + 현재가 근접, 돌파 시 추가 상승 가능성
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (5일 고가 $0.25, 20일 고가 $0.25): 고점 형성 후 횡보 국면
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (5일 평균 대비 1.57배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 상승
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세) + 0.26 저항 돌파 시 매수 진입, 실패 시 관망 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.26) vs SMA5/20/50 ($0.24/$0.22/$0.21): Short-to-mid term trend above, confirming bullish position.
· SMA100/200 ($0.19/$0.21) comparison: Maintaining mid-to-long term trend strength.
· 52-week position (15.5%) + Trading above historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (48.8→72.2) + Entering overbought + Maintaining upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -0.0024→0.0042) + Diagnosed as improving + Confirmed trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper band $0.25) + Bandwidth at 27.37% indicating expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.25) + Based on Pivot S1 and 5-day low.
· Swing resistance ($0.26) + Approaching current price, potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day high $0.25, 20-day high $0.25): Plateauing after highs, sideways consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.57x 5-day average) + Increased confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + Buy entry on breaking $0.26 resistance, otherwise wait-and-see.
